name: Crystal stag
notes: Origin on the ground between the hooves, face +Z, up +Y, 7 m to the antler tips. Joints walk -1...1 (diagonal leg pairs swing 22 deg about X, positive swings front-left forward), head -1...1 (neck and head yaw 35 deg, positive toward +X), rear 0...1 (body pitches up 38 deg about the hind hooves), glow 0...1 are empty drivers; child parts mimic them. Option parts lamps (veins) and tips (antler crystal tips) switch at glow 0.05, with two cyan point lights.
parts: lofted quartz barrel, 40 stations by 64 radial points
faceted ice-glass shell over the barrel, flat-shaded jittered facets
seven cyan veins under the shell
four legs as 48-sided tapered tubes with hip muscle masses and frosted glass hooves
48-sided neck with a ring of crystal shell plates, head, muzzle, nose, ears, glossy eyes
hex crystal ridge along the spine
antler tree of 48 tapered branches with a hex crystal tip on each
style: Stag of faceted ice crystal: pale quartz body under clear faceted ice glass, glowing cyan veins, crystal antler tree with glowing tips, frosted hooves. Original design.
summary: 7 m crystal stag: quartz body under a faceted ice-glass shell, cyan veins, 48-branch crystal antler tree, frosted hooves.
